inspiration.observed_pattern: A multi-join revenue report groups by two dimensions with WITH ROLLUP and uses GROUPING() inside CASE expressions to label detail, subtotal, and grand-total rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as one catalog category with two order states. The focused report preserves the four-table join, COUNT(DISTINCT), ROUND, and MariaDB-compatible NULL checks for rollup labels because the grouped dimensions are NOT NULL, while removing the second category and unrelated rows.

fixture_notes: One category and two order states create two detail rows, one category subtotal, and one grand total. One order has two lines, preserving the distinct-order boundary.
determinism_notes: Order IDs, line IDs, category names, status values, quantities, prices, grouping dimensions, rollup labels, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE revenue_orders_min (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, order_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE revenue_lines_min (line_id INT PRIMARY KEY, order_id INT NOT NULL, product_id INT NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL, unit_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE revenue_products_min (product_id INT PRIMARY KEY, category_id INT NOT NULL, product_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE revenue_categories_min (category_id INT PRIMARY KEY, category_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.category_name IS NULL THEN '(all categories)' ELSE c.category_name END AS category_label, CASE WHEN o.order_status IS NULL THEN '(all statuses)' ELSE o.order_status END AS status_label, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(rl.quantity * rl.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_total FROM revenue_orders_min AS o JOIN revenue_lines_min AS rl ON rl.order_id = o.order_id JOIN revenue_products_min AS p ON p.product_id = rl.product_id JOIN revenue_categories_min AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name, o.order_status WITH ROLLUP

checks.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.category_name IS NULL THEN '(all categories)' ELSE c.category_name END AS category_label, CASE WHEN o.order_status IS NULL THEN '(all statuses)' ELSE o.order_status END AS status_label, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(rl.quantity * rl.unit_price), 2) AS revenue_total FROM revenue_orders_min AS o JOIN revenue_lines_min AS rl ON rl.order_id = o.order_id JOIN revenue_products_min AS p ON p.product_id = rl.product_id JOIN revenue_categories_min AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name, o.order_status WITH ROLLUP
SELECT order_id, order_status FROM revenue_orders_min ORDER BY order_id
